_note: Core mechanical reference for the D&D 2024 layer. Skills/conditions carry concise original descriptions of their mechanical effects; tables are game facts. Rules text drawn from the SRD 5.2 is credited in data/dnd/LICENSE.md.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Climbing, jumping, swimming, and feats of raw physical power such as grappling or shoving.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Keeping your balance and performing agile stunts like tumbles, flips, and staying upright on unstable footing.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Manual trickery: picking pockets, planting an object, or concealing a small item on your person.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Moving silently and staying hidden from notice.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: Recalling lore about spells, magic items, planes of existence, and arcane symbols.

skills.name: History
skills.description: Recalling lore about past events, ancient realms, wars, and lost civilizations.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Deducing clues, spotting hidden details, and reasoning out how something works.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Recalling lore about terrain, plants, animals, weather, and natural cycles.

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: Recalling lore about deities, rites, holy symbols, and the practices of the faithful.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.description: Calming, controlling, or reading the intentions of a beast or mount.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Reading body language and intent to determine a creature's true feelings or catch a lie.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Stabilizing the dying and diagnosing an illness or injury.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Noticing things around you using sight, hearing, and your other senses.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Following tracks, foraging, navigating the wilds, and predicting the weather.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Convincingly hiding the truth through words or actions.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Influencing a creature through overt threats, hostile actions, or menacing presence.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Delighting an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling, or other entertainment.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Influencing a creature with tact, social grace, or good nature.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: You can't see and automatically fail any check that requires sight. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: You can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact with you socially.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: You can't hear and automatically fail any check that requires hearing.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Measured in levels. Each level gives a −2 penalty per level to d20 Tests and reduces your Speed by 5 feet per level. You die at level 6. A Long Rest removes one level.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of your fear is within line of sight, and you can't willingly move closer to it.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Your Speed is 0. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler. The condition ends if the grappler is Incapacitated or you're moved away.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.description: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; you can't concentrate; your Speed is 0; and you can't speak haltingly at best.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: You can't be seen without the aid of magic or a special sense; you're considered Heavily Obscured. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: You're Incapacitated and can't move or speak. You fail STR and DEX saves. Attacks against you have Advantage, and any attack that hits you from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: You're transformed into a solid substance, Incapacitated, and unaware of your surroundings. Attacks against you have Advantage; you fail STR and DEX saves and have Resistance to all damage and Immunity to poison and disease.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Your only movement option is to crawl unless you stand up. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attacks against you have Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet, otherwise Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Your Speed is 0. Attacks against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage. You have Disadvantage on DEX saves.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: You're Incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. You fail STR and DEX saves, and attacks against you have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: You're Incapacitated, can't move or speak, and are unaware of your surroundings. You drop what you're holding and fall Prone. You fail STR and DEX saves; attacks against you have Advantage and are Critical Hits if the attacker is within 5 feet.
